title: Photochemical CO2 Reduction by an NADH Model Compound in the Presence of [Ru(bpy)3]2+ and [Ru(bpy)2(CO)2]2+ (bpy = 2,2′-bipyridine) in H2O / DMF
abstract: Abstract                Photochemical conversion of CO2 to CO and HCOO− was achieved by using an NADH model compound, 1-benzyl-1,4-dihydronicotinamide (BNAH), as an electron donor in the presence of [Ru(bpy3]2+ (bpy = 2,2′-bipyridine) and [Ru(bpy)2(CO)2]2+ in H2O / DMF. The quantum yields for the CO and HCOO− formation attained 14.8 and 2.7%, respectively, in H2O/DMF (1:9 v/v).
